name: 林雅惠
objective:
本課程在使學生瞭解策略管理的意義及其演進, 如何建立公司策略以增加之競爭力。課程主要內容包括：1. 策略管理的意義, 2. 企業內外在環境分析, 3. 策略制定, 4. 策略執行與評估, 5. 事業階層策略, 6. 公司策略, 7. 購併。
The objective of the course is to establish a set of frameworks for the formulation and implementation of strategy. Topics of the course include SWOT, strategy formulation, strategy implementation, business-level strategy, corporate-level strategy, and merger & acquisition.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week1: Introduction of the Course/What is Strategy?(I)
Week2:What is Strategy?(II)
Week3:Assessing Organizational Performance
Week4:Evaluating the General Environment
Week5: Evaluating the Industry Environment(I)
Week6:Evaluating the Industry Environment(II)
Week7:Resource and Capability (I)
Week8:Resource and Capability (II)
Week9:Midterm
Week10:Business-Level Strategy through "Generic Strategies (I)
Week11: Business-Level Strategy through "Generic Strategies"(II)
Week12:Innovation strategies 
Week13:Global strategies 
Week14: Final Presentation
Week15:Final Presentation
Week16: Final exam
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Week17: Final Report Revision Workshop
Week18: Revised Final Report Submission and Course Reflection
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          完成期末報告修改後，學生應能：
1. 根據教師與同儕回饋，修正並提升策略管理報告的品質。
2. 反思策略分析的優點與限制，並說明報告修改的內容與理由。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          期末報告：30%

期末報告成績將以修正版報告的整體品質為評分依據，包括修改是否適當回應所獲得的回饋，以及是否有效提升報告的分析品質、邏輯一致性與策略建議的可行性。
